title: Investor Profiling Questionnaire
description: Week 2 baseline questionnaire for collecting structured investor answers before any portfolio recommendation is generated.

questions.text: In how many years will you need to start withdrawing funds from this account?
questions.help_text: This helps us judge how much time the portfolio has to recover from market swings.

options.label: Less than 3 years
options.description: Short timeline. The portfolio should stay safer and more liquid.

options.label: 6-10 years
options.description: Moderate timeline with some room for market fluctuations.

options.label: 11+ years
options.description: Long timeline. The portfolio can generally tolerate more volatility.

questions.text: How would you describe your investment knowledge?
questions.help_text: This is not the same as risk tolerance, but it helps explain how confidently someone may handle volatility.

options.label: None
options.description: Very little familiarity with investment concepts.

options.label: Limited
options.description: Some awareness but not much hands-on experience.

questions.text: When you hear "risk" related to your finances, what comes closest to your view?

options.label: I worry that I could be left with too little.
I understand that risk is part of investing.
I see risk as the path to stronger returns.
I enjoy the excitement of investing.

questions.text: What would you most likely do if your investments fell by 20% over a short period?
questions.help_text: This captures loss tolerance using a concrete scenario.

options.label: Buy more while prices are lower

questions.text: Which outcome matters more for this account?
questions.help_text: This tells us whether the portfolio should lean toward current income or long-term growth.

options.label: Regular income now or very soon
Mostly income with some growth
options.description: Income matters more than capital appreciation.

options.label: A balanced mix of income and growth
Mostly growth with some income
options.description: Growth matters more than cash flow.

questions.text: Which statement best matches why this money is being invested?
questions.help_text: This helps decide how much liquidity and stability the portfolio should preserve.

options.label: This money is a safety net for emergencies.
options.description: Very high need for liquidity and stability.

options.label: I expect to use this for a major expense soon.
I have a large future goal like a house, car, or wedding.
I want this to grow for retirement later on.
I mainly want to build long-term wealth.
